title: Help & adoption
quickstart: Pick your role on Guide & tours, or take the five-minute tour.
Read Ethics & values before you plan anything: it decides how you run a campaign.
Check Safeguarding & support, and keep the helplines to hand.
Use Trusted sources to back every claim with an official source.
Tell us what is missing on Have your say.

Plan a campaign from hub to launch window, coalition, toolkit, pledges, news hooks, policy and constituencies.

steps: Take the MYP or new-here tour.
Choose one issue from Issue domains and check it in Trusted sources.
Score your launch window before you set a date.
Line up an adult ally before you go public.
Take the parents and carers tour.
Read Backing a young campaigner on Safeguards & audiences.
Keep the NSPCC Helpline and Childline details to hand.
Help them register to vote when they are old enough.
Use the Academy for citizenship or PSHE lessons.
Run a UK Parliament Week activity from the launch page.
Follow your school's safeguarding procedures; Amplify signposts, it does not replace them.
Share the portal link; nobody needs an account.

tutorials.title: Plan a campaign in 20 minutes
steps: Open Launch window and pick a date outside exam season.
Open Coalition and list three adult allies.
Open Toolkit and make the pack for your first audience.
Open Momentum and note the daily rate you need.

tutorials.title: Find trusted help, fast
steps: Open Safeguarding & support for helplines that are free and confidential.
In an emergency, call 999.
For an online sexual approach, report to CEOP.
For more, filter Trusted sources by Safety or Wellbeing.

tutorials.title: Check a fact before you use it
steps: Search Trusted sources for the topic.
Prefer cards marked Verified; treat Leads as things to confirm.
Open the source and find the sentence you need.
Note the date you checked it.
